scripts.comment:test: TZ pin matches engine's local-time design (audit C-19, Slice 13a). Numeric outputs are TZ-stable but serialized Date fields aren't, so snapshot tests need a canonical TZ. America/New_York is the project's canonical authoring TZ. CI sets the same TZ at the workflow level.
scripts.comment:dev: First build engines once so dist/ exists for the app's initial Vite resolve, then run the engines' tsc --watch alongside the app's Vite dev server. `pnpm -r --parallel run dev` runs `dev` in every package that defines it; engines emit JS into dist/ on every save and Vite picks the new bundle up live.
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter '!@procsim/app' -r run build && pnpm -r --parallel run dev
